senses.gloss: f.(b. h.; מָשַׁח I)official distinction, official emoluments.
units: Y. Bicc. II, 64ᵈ (ref. to Num. XVIII, 8) למ׳ לגדולה למ׳ וכ׳ l’moshḥa means for official distinction, for anointing (the body) &c., v. הַדְלָקָה; Zeb. 28ᵃ, a. e. למ׳ לגדולה וכ׳ l’moshḥa means for distinction, as kings eat.
